title: Interaction Pattern Library
purpose: Atomic, reusable design ideas abstracted away from the sites that inspired them. Each pattern is stated generically enough to be re-implemented originally, per the LEARN -> ABSTRACT -> RECOMBINE -> BUILD rule. Nothing here describes proprietary code; these are technique descriptions.

patterns.name: Velocity skew
patterns.description: Elements skew, stretch or blur in proportion to scroll or drag acceleration, then settle elastically to rest. Encodes momentum as visible deformation, so the page feels like it has mass.
patterns.output: skewY or scaleY on a wrapper; optional directional blur
patterns.mobile: Halve the max skew; touch scroll already carries inertia so the effect double-counts.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Disable entirely under prefers-reduced-motion; layout is unchanged so nothing is lost.

patterns.name: Velocity-sensitive horizontal media ribbon
patterns.description: A horizontally scrolling strip of media where each item skews proportional to scroll acceleration and settles elastically, with items scaling slightly toward the viewport centre.
patterns.trigger: vertical scroll mapped to horizontal translation, or direct drag
patterns.output: translateX on track, per-item skew and scale
patterns.mobile: Switch to native horizontal overflow with scroll-snap; drop the pin.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Keyboard arrow navigation between items; ensure the track is reachable and not a scroll trap.

patterns.name: Scroll-driven camera dolly
patterns.description: Scroll position drives a 3D camera along a spline through a scene rather than translating DOM. The page becomes a corridor; sections are locations rather than blocks.
patterns.trigger: scroll progress 0-1 over a pinned section
patterns.output: camera position and quaternion per frame
patterns.mobile: Reduce DPR to <=1.5, cut postprocessing, shorten the path, or fall back to an image sequence.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Provide a plain DOM version of the same content; do not trap scroll.

patterns.name: Shader image reveal
patterns.description: Images enter through a GPU transition driven by a noise or gradient map rather than opacity - dissolve, liquid wipe, pixel shatter, or displacement warp. Reveal shape carries brand character.
patterns.trigger: intersection observer, hover, or scroll progress
patterns.output: fragment shader mixing texture against threshold
patterns.mobile: Reduce texture resolution; cap concurrent animating planes to ~3.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Render the plain and skip the transition under reduced-motion.

patterns.name: DOM-synced WebGL image plane
patterns.description: Every in normal document flow is mirrored by a WebGL plane matched to its bounding box. The DOM stays semantic and accessible; the canvas provides the effects layer.
patterns.output: positioned textured planes in an orthographic scene
patterns.mobile: Fall back to plain DOM images below a width threshold.
patterns.a11y_fallback: This IS the fallback pattern - the real DOM is always present, canvas is decoration.

patterns.name: Cursor-tethered image preview
patterns.description: Hovering a text list spawns a media preview that trails the cursor with spring lag, swapping content per row and often stacking or rotating slightly per entry.
patterns.trigger: pointer enter on a list row
patterns.output: absolutely positioned media following pointer with damping
patterns.mobile: Replace with an inline thumbnail per row - the pattern has no touch equivalent.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Preview must be decorative only; the row link carries the real information.

patterns.name: Magnetic control
patterns.description: A button or link attracts the cursor within a radius, translating toward the pointer with damping and snapping back on exit. Its label often moves at a different rate than its container, creating parallax within the control.
patterns.trigger: pointer within N px of element centre
patterns.output: translate on container and inner label at differing rates
patterns.mobile: Disable; provide a press-scale response instead.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Must not affect hit area. Keyboard focus produces an equivalent visual state.

patterns.name: Cursor-driven distortion field
patterns.description: Pointer position feeds a shader uniform that locally warps an image, mesh or gradient - ripple, lens, heat-haze or fluid smear that decays over time so the cursor leaves a wake.
patterns.output: displacement applied in fragment shader; often a ping-pong FBO for the trail
patterns.mobile: Drive from touch position, reduce FBO resolution, or disable.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Purely decorative; must be skippable and must not gate content.

patterns.name: Cursor spotlight mask
patterns.description: A radial mask follows the pointer, revealing a second layer beneath - inverted colours, an alternate image, or hidden text. Content is discovered rather than displayed.
patterns.output: CSS mask-image radial-gradient or clip-path on an overlay layer
patterns.mobile: Anchor the spotlight to scroll position, or reveal fully.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Hidden layer must be redundant, never the only copy of information.

patterns.name: Sticky scene narrative
patterns.description: A pinned viewport holds one visual while text panels advance through it, each step mutating the visual. Scroll becomes a slideshow controller rather than a translation.
patterns.trigger: scroll progress within a pinned container
patterns.output: discrete state changes plus continuous interpolation
patterns.mobile: Shorten pin distance; ensure each step fits one viewport with room for the text.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Steps must be real DOM sections readable in order with no scroll hijack.

patterns.name: Scroll-progress typography
patterns.description: A variable font's axes are wired to scroll progress or velocity - weight, width, slant or optical size shifting as the reader moves. Text becomes an instrument for reading pace.
patterns.output: font-variation-settings updated per frame
patterns.mobile: Works well; cap axis range so text stays legible at small sizes.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Freeze to the mid-axis value under reduced-motion; never let weight drop below readable.

patterns.name: Character-level kinetic typography
patterns.description: Text is split to character or word level and animated on a stagger, along a path, or with per-glyph physics. The headline performs rather than appears.
patterns.output: per-glyph transform and opacity
patterns.mobile: Reduce stagger; large splits cost layout on low-end devices.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Keep the original text node intact for screen readers; aria-hidden the split copy.

patterns.name: Scramble / decode text
patterns.description: Characters cycle through random glyphs before resolving to the final string, per-character on a stagger. Reads as machine decoding.
patterns.output: progressive per-character resolution
patterns.mobile: Fine; shorten duration.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Announce only the final string; never expose intermediate noise to assistive tech.

patterns.name: Text mask reveal
patterns.description: Type is clipped to reveal video, imagery or a shader beneath, so the headline is a window rather than a colour.
patterns.output: background-clip: text, SVG mask, or shader alpha
patterns.mobile: Ensure fallback colour - clipped text over busy media loses contrast fast.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Provide a solid-colour fallback meeting contrast; the text must remain selectable.

patterns.name: Liquid / curtain page transition
patterns.description: Route changes are covered by a shaped wipe - a curved curtain, a growing blob, or a shader dissolve - that both hides the swap and carries brand character.
patterns.output: overlay animation gated on route resolution
patterns.mobile: Shorten to <400ms; long transitions feel broken on touch.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Skip the overlay under reduced-motion; move focus to the new page heading either way.

patterns.name: Shared-element morph
patterns.description: An element common to two views animates continuously between its positions across the navigation, so the two pages read as one continuous space.
patterns.trigger: route navigation with a matched element
patterns.output: FLIP-style interpolation of position, size and radius
patterns.mobile: Works well; keep under 350ms.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Cross-fade under reduced-motion; move focus explicitly.

patterns.name: Persistent canvas across routes
patterns.description: A single WebGL context lives above the router and survives navigation, so 3D state carries between pages while DOM swaps beneath it. Eliminates re-initialisation cost and enables continuous camera moves between routes.
patterns.trigger: app mount; route changes mutate scene state
patterns.output: one long-lived renderer, tweened between route states
patterns.mobile: Single context is a benefit; still cap DPR and pause RAF when hidden.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Canvas is decoration; DOM routing must work with it removed.

patterns.name: Loader-to-hero handoff
patterns.description: The loading sequence is composed as the first beat of the hero rather than a separate screen - the counter, mark or mask resolves directly into the hero layout.
patterns.output: continuous animation from loader state into hero state
patterns.mobile: Enforce a maximum wait; never block first paint on non-critical assets.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Content readable if the loader is skipped; announce load completion.

patterns.name: Infinite spatial gallery
patterns.description: A boundlessly pannable plane or volume of media where the viewport wraps, so there is no edge. Navigation is exploration rather than pagination.
patterns.output: modulo-wrapped positions with recycled tiles
patterns.mobile: Touch-drag with inertia; reduce visible tile count.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Offer a flat linear list of the same items.

patterns.name: Zoomable world / deep zoom
patterns.description: Navigation is scale rather than position - zooming in reveals nested levels of detail, each a distinct scene. Depth replaces the page stack.
patterns.output: scale transform with content swapped at LOD boundaries
patterns.mobile: Pinch works naturally; ensure a zoom-out affordance exists.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Provide breadcrumb navigation and keyboard zoom controls.

patterns.name: Perspective card stack
patterns.description: Cards recede in Z with progressive scale and blur, advancing on scroll or drag so the stack reads as physical depth rather than a list.
patterns.output: translateZ/scale/blur per card
patterns.mobile: Reduce stack depth to 3 visible; blur is expensive on low-end GPUs.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Cards are a normal list in DOM order; keyboard moves through them.

patterns.name: Physics-driven DOM objects
patterns.description: Interface elements are rigid bodies - they drop, collide, stack and can be thrown. Layout is simulated rather than specified.
patterns.output: physics step driving element transforms
patterns.mobile: Cap body count; add a device-orientation gravity option as a bonus.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Render a static laid-out version under reduced-motion; content must not depend on simulation.

patterns.name: Physics typography
patterns.description: Individual glyphs are physical bodies that collide, pile and scatter under gravity or pointer force. The wordmark is a toy.
patterns.trigger: load, pointer push, or device tilt
patterns.output: per-glyph position and rotation from simulation
patterns.mobile: Limit glyph count; use device orientation for gravity.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Real text present and readable; simulation layer aria-hidden.

patterns.name: Gravity / elastic menu
patterns.description: Navigation items hang, swing or stretch on invisible constraints, responding to pointer and momentum like objects on strings.
patterns.output: constrained body positions driving item transforms
patterns.mobile: Works with touch; keep hit areas static regardless of visual offset.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Static menu under reduced-motion; keyboard order unaffected.

patterns.name: Elastic dock
patterns.description: A row of items scales based on distance from the pointer, producing a smooth magnification wave along the row.
patterns.output: per-item scale and spacing with spring damping
patterns.mobile: Disable magnification; use a plain row with press feedback.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Scale must not change hit targets or reading order.

patterns.name: Audio-reactive visual field
patterns.description: FFT bands from a live or file audio source drive shader uniforms or particle forces, so visuals are literally the sound's shape.
patterns.output: uniforms driving displacement, colour, particle velocity
patterns.mobile: Autoplay is blocked - require an explicit gesture; reduce bin count.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Never audio-only. Provide a visible mute control and a silent visual mode.

patterns.name: Interaction sound design
patterns.description: A restrained, procedurally varied sound layer responds to hover, click and section change - pitch or timbre shifting so repetition never feels mechanical.
patterns.output: short synthesised or sampled cues with varied pitch
patterns.mobile: Requires a user gesture to unlock audio; default to off.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Off by default with a persistent, discoverable toggle. Never convey information by sound alone.

patterns.name: GPU particle field
patterns.description: Hundreds of thousands of particles simulated in textures on the GPU, flowing along noise fields, forming shapes, or reacting to pointer and audio.
patterns.output: ping-pong FBO simulation rendered as points
patterns.mobile: Drop particle count by an order of magnitude, or substitute a static render.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Purely decorative; pause when off-screen and under reduced-motion.

patterns.name: Particle text formation
patterns.description: Particles disperse and reassemble into glyph shapes sampled from a canvas render of the text, scattering on pointer proximity.
patterns.output: particles lerping toward target positions
patterns.mobile: Reduce sample density substantially.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Real text present beneath; particle layer aria-hidden.

patterns.name: ASCII / halftone render pass
patterns.description: A post-process converts the rendered scene into characters or dot patterns, quantising luminance into a glyph or dot ramp. Turns 3D into texture and text.
patterns.output: luminance-quantised fragment output
patterns.mobile: Increase cell size to reduce fragment work.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Decorative; ensure any text conveyed this way also exists as real text.

patterns.name: Dither / halftone treatment
patterns.description: Ordered Bayer or error-diffusion dithering quantises imagery to a tiny palette, giving a print or early-computing texture that survives at any scale.
patterns.output: quantised fragment colour
tech: CSS + SVG filters for cheap variants
patterns.mobile: Cheap; works well.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Verify contrast after quantisation - dithering can destroy it.

patterns.name: Noise / grain overlay
patterns.description: An animated film-grain layer over the whole page. The single cheapest way to stop a flat digital surface reading as sterile.
patterns.output: screen or overlay blended full-viewport layer
patterns.mobile: Use a static tiled texture rather than animated noise.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Keep opacity low enough not to affect text contrast; disable if animated under reduced-motion.

patterns.name: Animated mesh gradient
patterns.description: Slowly drifting multi-point colour field rendered as a shader or blurred blobs, giving depth without literal imagery.
patterns.output: smoothly interpolated background
patterns.mobile: Render at reduced resolution and upscale; or use a static export.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Ensure text contrast against the darkest and lightest states, not just the average.

patterns.name: Image trail
patterns.description: Cursor movement leaves a decaying trail of images that fade and scale out, sampled at a distance threshold so speed controls density.
patterns.trigger: pointer move past a distance threshold
patterns.output: pooled elements spawned along the path
patterns.mobile: Disable; there is no hover path on touch.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Decorative only; must not obscure content or block clicks.

patterns.name: Animated topographic field
patterns.description: Contour lines or a wireframe surface deform under noise or data, giving a sense of terrain and slow geological motion.
patterns.output: marching-squares contours or displaced mesh wireframe
patterns.mobile: Reduce grid resolution.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Decorative; if it encodes data, provide a table.

patterns.name: Flow field drift
patterns.description: Agents trace paths through a curl-noise vector field, accumulating into hair-like or smoke-like structure over time.
patterns.output: accumulated strokes on a canvas that never fully clears
patterns.mobile: Reduce agents; the accumulation buffer is the expensive part.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Decorative; freeze on a rendered still under reduced-motion.

patterns.name: Portal / stencil window
patterns.description: A shape in the page is a window into a different 3D space, rendered via stencil or render target. Walking the camera through it becomes a scene transition.
patterns.output: stencil-masked or render-target-textured surface
patterns.mobile: Two scenes means two render passes - consider a flat texture substitute.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Decorative; provide standard navigation to the same destination.

patterns.name: Gaussian splat hero
patterns.description: A photoreal captured scene rendered as splats, orbited slowly or driven by scroll, with crisp DOM typography overlaid. Photographic realism plus editorial type is a combination the web has barely used.
patterns.trigger: load, then scroll or pointer orbit
patterns.output: splat rasterisation behind a DOM overlay
patterns.mobile: Assets are large - gate on connection quality and fall back to a still render.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Static poster image; all copy lives in the DOM overlay regardless.

patterns.name: Diegetic interface
patterns.description: Controls exist inside the fiction of the scene - a physical switch, a printed sign, an object you pick up - rather than floating as chrome. Borrowed from game design.
patterns.trigger: proximity or click on in-world objects
patterns.output: in-scene affordance changes
patterns.mobile: Enlarge interaction volumes considerably for touch.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Mandatory parallel conventional navigation - this pattern is otherwise a hard accessibility failure.

patterns.name: Environmental storytelling
patterns.description: Information is embedded in the scene and discovered by exploration rather than delivered in sequence - the arrangement of things IS the copy.
patterns.output: progressive revelation as regions are visited
patterns.mobile: Shorten exploration distance; signal that there is more to find.
patterns.a11y_fallback: All narrative content must also exist in linear readable form.

patterns.name: Rewarded discovery
patterns.description: A hidden interaction - a konami code, a draggable object, a long-press - unlocks a small delight. Costs little, generates disproportionate memorability and word of mouth.
patterns.output: one-off animation, mode change, or hidden content
patterns.mobile: Give it a touch equivalent - shake, long-press, multi-touch.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Never hide required content here. Purely a bonus.

patterns.name: Live multiplayer cursors
patterns.description: Other visitors' pointers are visible in real time, optionally with names or reactions. Turns a solitary page into an inhabited space.
patterns.output: interpolated remote cursor rendering
patterns.mobile: No pointer to broadcast - show presence count or tap ripples instead.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Decorative; announce presence count textually if it matters.

patterns.name: Context-reactive page
patterns.description: The page responds to the visitor's real-world context - local time of day, weather, timezone, battery, or coarse location - so no two visits look identical.
patterns.output: palette, lighting, ambient motion and copy variants
patterns.mobile: Battery and connection signals are especially meaningful here - use them to pick the perf tier too.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Contrast must hold in every generated variant; test the extremes, not the average.

patterns.name: Terminal / command interface
patterns.description: Navigation by typed command rather than clicking, with autocomplete and history. Extremely fast for expert users and instantly characterful.
patterns.output: streamed text response and route changes
patterns.mobile: Touch keyboards make this painful - always pair with conventional navigation.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Screen readers handle text well, but use aria-live for output and never make it the only route.

patterns.name: Desktop / window metaphor
patterns.description: Content lives in draggable, resizable, stackable windows with a menu bar. Non-linear by construction - the visitor arranges their own reading.
patterns.trigger: click to open, drag to move
patterns.output: managed window instances
patterns.mobile: Collapse to full-screen sheets; windowing does not survive small viewports.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Windows need focus trapping, escape-to-close, and correct roles - treat each as a dialog.

patterns.name: Comparison reveal
patterns.description: A draggable divider wipes between two states - before/after, day/night, wireframe/render - using clip-path rather than opacity so the edge stays crisp.
patterns.output: clip-path inset on the top layer
patterns.mobile: Works well; make the handle large.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Expose as a slider role with keyboard arrow control.

patterns.name: Velocity-coupled marquee
patterns.description: A looping ticker whose speed and direction are modulated by scroll velocity, so it lurches with the page rather than running at a constant rate.
patterns.output: translateX on a duplicated track
patterns.mobile: Fine; reduce speed.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Pause under reduced-motion and on focus; duplicated content must be aria-hidden.

patterns.name: Spatialised scene audio
patterns.description: Sound sources are positioned in the 3D scene and panned by camera relation, so audio conveys direction and distance as the visitor moves.
patterns.output: PannerNode-processed audio
patterns.mobile: Gate on a gesture; consider stereo-only fallback.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Never encode required information positionally in audio; provide captions and a mute.

patterns.name: Gooey merge
patterns.description: An SVG blur-plus-contrast filter makes separate shapes merge and separate like liquid as they approach - a metaball effect at almost no cost.
patterns.output: filtered composite of the shape group
patterns.mobile: SVG filters are costly on some mobile GPUs - test, and cap the blur radius.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Decorative; ensure filtered text remains legible or is not text.

patterns.name: Path drawing
patterns.description: Strokes draw themselves via dash-offset animation, tied to scroll or entrance, so diagrams and illustrations construct in front of the reader.
patterns.output: stroke-dashoffset interpolation
patterns.mobile: Cheap and effective.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Show the completed path under reduced-motion; provide a text description.

patterns.name: Shape morph
patterns.description: One silhouette interpolates into another via path interpolation, letting icons, logos and illustrations transform continuously rather than cross-fade.
patterns.output: interpolated path d attribute
patterns.mobile: Fine.
patterns.a11y_fallback: State must also be conveyed by label or aria-state, not shape alone.

patterns.name: Scroll-scrubbed image sequence
patterns.description: Scroll position indexes a pre-rendered frame sequence, giving cinematic control with none of a live 3D scene's runtime cost. Compression and preload strategy are the whole engineering problem.
patterns.trigger: scroll progress over a pinned section
patterns.output: canvas drawImage of the current frame
patterns.mobile: Serve a much shorter sequence at lower resolution; never ship hundreds of full-size frames.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Provide a poster frame and a text description; do not trap scroll.

patterns.name: Data as terrain
patterns.description: A dataset is rendered as an explorable 3D landscape rather than a chart - height, density and colour encode variables, and navigation is flight rather than filtering.
patterns.output: displaced mesh or instanced columns with legend
patterns.mobile: Reduce grid resolution; consider a 2D heatmap fallback.
patterns.a11y_fallback: Mandatory accessible data table and text summary of the finding.
